spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact four-field IAMF codec string (iamf.<primary>.<additional>.<codec>) against MediaSource.isTypeSupported, canPlayType and mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo — the real support surfaces, grounded in the AOMedia registration.

interactive.rationale: Four labelled selects re-run the probe on every change; the built string, verdict, field table and one-field-variant neighbour table all update live (verified: readouts changed after each select change).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises assembling a string from its parts with live probing, and that is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the casing trap (opus vs Opus), an out-of-range profile (255), a webm container, a profile-less iamf string and a non-IAMF control so a false answer can be read against neighbours.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416 and the AOMedia IAMF spec in see-also.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts the MSE/canPlayType/decodingInfo contracts for real IAMF strings plus the probe-integrity control; 6 pass / 0 fail / 0 blocked on this Chromium 153 build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: All controls exercised, zero console errors, zero failed requests, both-viewport screenshots clean; on this Chromium 153 the default string probes as supported — the real success path, not just the fallback.

telemetry_health.rationale: The page emits codec-string-probed on every run, but the assert condition is the literal true, so it can never record a failure — it is an event, not a contract assertion.

design_system.rationale: All colours via CSS variables, verdict/banner pairs meet AA, selects and inputs are 44px minimum, no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Every select has a visible label, outputs use aria-live=polite, 12/12 tab stops showed a visible focus indicator.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (measured 0px); tables sit in overflow-x scrollers; controls legible and tappable on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Make the codec-string-probed telemetry assert falsifiable
openQuestions.detail: showcaseTelemetry.assert('codec-string-probed', true, …) can never fail. Assert a real invariant instead — e.g. that the plain-Opus control probes as supported whenever MSE exists — so production telemetry can catch a broken probe.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. The builder exercises the exact IAMF codec-string contract against all three support APIs; on this Chromium 153 build the strings genuinely probe as supported, so the success path was observed live. Only gap: the telemetry assert is unfalsifiable.
